brief: Two bases side by side joined with side connectors, each with a bin.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: connector:0#0,0|1,0 side-connector-double between q0,0 and q1,0
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full on first base, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full on second base

finish.summary: Built two full bases at 0,0,0 and 1,0,0 joined by side-connector-double, each fitted with full bin.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Got it — two linked bases, each with a bin. I'll set that up.

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

warnings.message: 1 part(s) could slide apart (1 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.

offersNear.note: Open offers at the base just added (valid until the next change): apply one by its socket, no find_sockets needed.

events.text: Your two-base unit is together — I'll do the finishing checks to finalize it.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
